items.title: 22.6.1 Reactions of the -OH Group in Phenols (phenol ke -OH group ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.6.1, printed pages 92-93 (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Phenols ka -OH group slightly (halka sa) acidic hai. Is liye phenol acid ka kaam kar sakta hai aur acid-base reactions mein hissa leta hai.
i. Reaction with bases (bases se reaction)

Phenols paani mein slightly soluble (bohat kam ghulne wale) hain, kyun ke in ki bari benzene ring non-polar hai. Lekin yeh alkaline (base wale) solutions mein ghul jate hain: base se acid-base reaction kar ke soluble (ghulne wala) salt aur paani banate hain.

blocks.alt: Phenol (acid), OH wala benzene ring, + NaOH (base) se sodium phenoxide, O- Na+ wala ring, + H2O. Labels: phenol, sodium hydroxide, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: i) Phenol aur sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF page 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenol yahan acid hai aur NaOH base. Phenol ka H⁺ OH⁻ se mil kar paani banata hai, aur sodium phenoxide (C₆H₅O⁻Na⁺) ka ghulne wala salt bachta hai.
ii. Reaction with reactive metals (reactive metals se reaction)
Molten (pighla hua) phenol sodium (Na) jaisi reactive metals se vigorously (zor se) react karta hai. Yeh bhi acid-base reaction hai. Is mein soluble salt banta hai aur hydrogen gas nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: 2 phenol + 2Na se 2 sodium phenoxide (O- Na+ wala ring) + H2. Labels: phenol, sodium, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: ii) Phenol aur sodium (kitab ke PDF page 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein left side sirf ek phenol aur 2Na chhapa hai, jab ke right side 2 sodium phenoxide hain, yani equation balanced nahi. Sahi: 2 phenol + 2Na → 2 sodium phenoxide + H₂, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har phenol ka O-H bond toot'ta hai; O⁻ sodium ke Na⁺ ke saath salt banata hai aur do phenol molecules ke do H mil kar ek H₂ molecule banate hain.
iii. Reaction with acyl chloride (acyl chloride se reaction)

Phenol ko base ki presence (maujoodgi) mein acyl chloride ke saath garam karne par ester banta hai. Base phenol se proton hata kar (deprotonate kar ke) phenoxide ion banata hai. Phenoxide ion asal phenol molecule se better (behtar) nucleophile (positive carbon par attack karne wala) hai, is liye yeh carbonyl carbon par attack kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke phenol aur acyl chloride ke reaction se ether banta hai. Product, phenyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₆H₅), ester hai, jaisa kitab ki apni equation dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + phenol, HO-C6H5, arrow ke oopar NaOH aur neeche Heat, se phenyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-C6H5, + HCl.
blocks.caption: iii) Ethanoyl chloride aur phenol se phenyl ethanoate (kitab ke PDF page 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Hydroxide ion apne lone pair se (curly arrow) phenol ke O-H ka H leta hai, aur doosra curly arrow O-H bond ke electrons ko O par le jata hai. Result: phenoxide ion, 'better nucleophile than the phenol', + H2O.
blocks.caption: Phenol aur hydroxide ion se phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF page 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH⁻ ka lone pair phenol ke H ko kheenchta hai (pehla curly arrow) aur O-H bond ke electrons O par chale jate hain (doosra curly arrow). Bachne wala phenoxide ion negative hai, is liye phenol se behtar nucleophile hai aur ethanoyl chloride ke carbonyl carbon par attack karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki drawing mein OH⁻ ke proton lene se banne wala paani (H₂O) nahi likha; hamari drawing mein '+ H₂O' add kiya gaya hai.
iv. Reaction with diazonium ions (diazonium ions se reaction)
Phenol ka yeh reaction Chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) mein parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Phenol sodium hydroxide ke solution mein kyun ghul jata hai, jab ke paani mein bohat kam ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Paani mein bara non-polar ring ghulne nahi deta; NaOH phenol ke acidic -OH se react kar ke ionic salt, sodium phenoxide, banata hai jo paani mein ghul jata hai.

items: Phenol + NaOH → sodium phenoxide + paani; phenol + Na → sodium phenoxide + H₂.
Phenol + acyl chloride (base, heat) → ester (phenyl ethanoate); base phenoxide ion banata hai jo better nucleophile hai.
Diazonium ions se reaction Chapter 24 mein.
